'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Hunter DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
* '''Username:''' Hunter
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
